description: This file is the entry point for a React application. It imports React and ReactDOM libraries, along with CSS styles and the main App component. It then creates a root element and renders the App component within React's StrictMode for highlighting potential issues.

methods.name: ReactDOM.createRoot
methods.description: Creates a React root for rendering the React component tree, targeting the DOM element with id 'root'.

methods.name: root.render
methods.description: Renders the given React element into the created React root, in this case wrapping the App component inside React.StrictMode.
